authors.removeConfirm_one:
Soft-delete "{name}" and their {count} book or series?

This hides the author tile and every descendant from the library. On-disk files are not touched. Use this to clear ghost rows from misorganised content (e.g. a multi-file book whose chapter tags split it under the wrong author).
authors.removeConfirm_other:
Soft-delete "{name}" and all {count} of their books/series?

This hides the author tile and every descendant from the library. On-disk files are not touched. Use this to clear ghost rows from misorganised content (e.g. a multi-file book whose chapter tags split it under the wrong author).

librarySettings.heading: Settings
librarySettings.name: Name
librarySettings.languageHelp: Movie and TV titles, summaries and genres come from TMDB in this language where TMDB has a translation; a missing summary falls back to English. Items already matched change on their next metadata refresh.
librarySettings.episodeOrderHelp: How your episode files are numbered. Aired follows the broadcast order; DVD and absolute (one running number, "Show - 123") look episodes up in that order instead, where the show's metadata provider has one. A show can override this from its page. Changing it refreshes the library's episode metadata in the background.
librarySettings.trickplayHelp: Preview frames shown while scrubbing, built in the background after each scan and nightly.
librarySettings.subAutoHelp: New movies and episodes without a subtitle in these languages get one from OpenSubtitles (comma-separated codes, e.g. {example}; blank uses the server's list). The server-wide setting and the provider account are under Settings › General.
librarySettings.rawToggle: Pair RAW files with their JPEGs
librarySettings.rawHelp: A RAW file (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF, ORF, RW2, PEF) and a JPEG with the same name in the same folder show as one photo: the JPEG is displayed, and "Download original" gives the RAW. Turn off to list them as separate photos. Takes effect on the next scan.
librarySettings.nfoCollectionsHelp: Each set (and tag) named in your movies' NFO files becomes a collection, listed by release date. Movies join as they're scanned; turning this on imports the existing ones in the background. Sets that are TMDB film series OnScreen already groups are skipped. Tags written by Radarr, Sonarr or TMDB scrapers are usually plot keywords, not collections — choose "Sets and tags" only if you tagged your movies yourself.
librarySettings.saveNfoToggle: Save metadata as NFO files next to media
librarySettings.saveNfoHelp: Writes Kodi-compatible movie.nfo / tvshow.nfo / episode NFO files beside your media after metadata is fetched, edited or re-matched, so Kodi, Jellyfin and Emby see the same details. NFO files OnScreen didn't write are never replaced. Needs write access to the media folders.
librarySettings.privateHelp: When on, only users explicitly granted access in {users} can see this library. When off, every authenticated user can see it.
librarySettings.autoGrantHelp: Newly-created accounts (invite, OIDC/SAML/LDAP sign-in) are automatically granted access to this library — useful on all-private installs to avoid first sign-in landing on a barren home page.
librarySettings.facesHelp: Faces are found by the opt-in "Photo face detection" task (Settings ▸ Tasks) and named by hand. Deleting removes every detected face and named person in this library; photos are not touched.
librarySettings.introHelp: Runs audio fingerprinting + black-frame analysis across every episode to find intros and credits. Safe to re-run — manual markers are preserved.
librarySettings.deleteLibrarySub: Removes all metadata. Files on disk are not affected.
librarySettings.deleteDialogBody: All metadata for this library will be permanently removed. Files on disk will not be deleted. This cannot be undone.
